title: Wind turbine gearbox DFMEA
goal: Show a risk-ranked DFMEA for a wind-turbine main gearbox.

rubric.must: A visible FMEA worksheet identifies Main gearbox and its function.
Each visible risk row presents severity, occurrence, detection, and RPN values.
The worksheet visibly includes gear tooth, bearing overheating, and vibration modes.
Each cause row visibly associates prevention and detection controls with the risk.
Higher-risk rows are visibly flagged or ranked distinctly from lower-risk rows.
Narrow numeric score columns remain visually distinct from descriptive failure-analysis columns.

ideal.notes: Independently authored against visual-eval/exemplars/fmea/ideal.svg (sha256 656f156ad4fb), source sha256 a9ce58f4ecf9. Independent worksheet with all causes, effects, controls and scores. Adjacent repeated cells merged; AP or RPN follows the source ranking method. AP values checked against the AIAG-VDA 2019 matrix documented by HBK ReliaSoft, https://reliasoftcloud.hbkworld.com/demo/help/content/risk_ranking_logic.htm, not the engine approximation. RPN is multiplied independently; no AP invented for the RPN-only case. All 21 risk-batch targets were rasterised with Resvg and visually inspected individually on 2026-09-14; this drawing was accepted for geometry, label readability and semantic traceability.
